title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: ‘Reiterates its call on the Member States, in the light of the regrettable decision of the US administration to cease all military assistance to Ukraine, along with intelligence sharing and access to satellite imagery, to substantially increase and accelerate their military support, in particular the provision of weapons and ammunition, as well as training, in response to pressing needs (inter alia long range weapons systems, air defence systems, artillery systems, electronic warfare systems, anti-drone capabilities and engineering equipment);’ without the words: ‘in the light of the regrettable decision of the US administration to cease all military assistance to Ukraine, along with intelligence sharing and access to satellite imagery,’
